notes.title: Update Available - 2021/01/15
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411212/a23dd7be8a8c1fb819bafd815c53ad8015b56a4c.png[/img]

Update released with the following fixes! Please update the game if you meet the following issues.

Fixes:
- Fixed the bug that prevents from advancing the game if non-English system languages are set
- Fixed the FPS issue occurring under certain environment.
- Improved UI of in-game Trophies screen
- Improved system behavior when transferring runes
- Fixed the numbers shown on progress bar when starting up the game
- Corrected typographical errors
